## Files

- system.json: discovered site contract

## Limits

This v0.5 prototype uses the static-html renderer: it fetches HTML, does not execute JavaScript, and crawls up to 10 same-origin pages linked from the homepage.
Robots.txt is fetched for awareness only and is not enforced yet.
